name: chief-of-staff-reconcile
description: Reconciles the Autopilot scheduled Chief of Staff ontology pipeline for a workspace after an assignment save, change, or removal. Enforces one schedule per (workspace_id, assigned_agent_npub), disables stale schedules on reassignment/removal, and publishes honest JobStatus to the active private cohort.

steps.name: Reconcile Chief of Staff Schedule
steps.description: Reads authoritative workspace Chief of Staff assignment from NStack, reconciles the exact Autopilot scheduled pipeline (creating, updating, or disabling stale schedules), and publishes updated JobStatus.
steps.prompt: Read the exact parameters from Selected input JSON (workspace_id, workspace_owner_npub, app_npub, tower_url, subscription_id, optional cron_expression defaulting to '0 * * * *', optional timezone defaulting to 'Australia/Perth', and optional cli_script_path defaulting to the repo's scripts/chief-of-staff/cli.mjs). Run: `bun <cli_script_path> reconcile-schedule --workspace <workspace_id> --owner <workspace_owner_npub> --app <app_npub> --tower <tower_url> --subscription <subscription_id> --cron '<cron_expression>' --timezone '<timezone>'`. Parse stdout as JSON and return that exact JSON object as your callback `result`.
